about: Claude Code screens as the account switcher reads them, each with the verdict it must give. backend/src/lib/accountSwitchCore.ts paneLimitState (scripts/accountSwitchSmoke.mts, scripts/accountContinueSmoke.mts) and the copy in thor's Continue-Stopped.ps1 (Test-ContinueStopped.ps1) are both held to it. "recorded" screens are tmux captures of Claude Code 2.1.303 on the switcher rig (fake API, dummy tokens); "win-console" screens are laid out the way a Windows console buffer reads back (fixed width, rows padded).
